stem_book: For the reaction R ⇌ P, variation of concentration is plotted against time (figure: [R] falls and [P] rises, they cross in region III, approach constancy in region II, and beyond the dashed line, region I, both are flat). Which of the following regions show(s) equilibrium? (a) I (b) II (c) III (d) Both II and III
work: Equilibrium only where both concentrations are constant with time -> region I.
